# Antec VP_P Plus Quiet Power Supplies

Antec’s VP_P Plus power supply series have been crafted for quality, performance and incredible value.

 Antec VP700P Plus

## Features

1. Continuous Power Guaranteed
2. 80 PLUS 200-240V Standard Certified
3. AQ3 - Antec Quality 3 year warranty
4. An advanced low voltage fan control for optimal heat & noise management
5. Full suite of industrial grade protections: UVP/OVP/SCP/OPP/NLO

Antec’s entry-level VP_P Plus power supplies are rated from 500W to 700W, they feature a quiet 120mm fan, single +12V rail, 85% efficient and is it also ‘80 PLUS 230V Standard’ certified.

### Delivering up to 85% efficiency

The VP_P PLUS series utilises active PFC and provides efficiency during max and low loads, living up to the performance standards that Antec are known for.

 Antec VP500P Plus

### 120 mm Quiet Fan

The 120 mm Quiet Fan is ideal for near-silent computing and is designed for longer life, guaranteeing hours of operation. Features a Thermal Manager, an advanced low voltage fan control for optimal heat and noise management, allowing the PSU to stay at the optimal temperature.

### Single 12V Rail Design

The VP_P series are equipped with a strong single +12V rail. The higher-ranking performance with high load capabilities ensures maximum CPU and GPU compatibility. 

### 3 Year Warranty

Antec stand by the quality and safety of the VP_P PLUS Power Supplies, offering a 3-year parts and labor warranty and unlimited access to their incomparable technical support and customer service if required.

PLEASE NOTE: These Antec PSUs have a voltage range of 200-240V, so they will not work in all countries around the world.
